stem.text: The diagram shows the stages in the production of part of a polypeptide.

stem.alt: Diagram of three stages: a DNA nucleotide sequence (template strand), an mRNA sequence and an amino acid sequence, each linked to the next by a downward arrow, with the printed sequences shown.

stem.text: Which feature of the triplet code is illustrated by the information given?

A.text: An amino acid can be coded for by more than one triplet.

B.text: The triplet code is non-overlapping and is only read in one direction.

C.text: The triplet code is universal for the DNA of all organisms.

D.text: There are some triplets that code for ‘start’ and ‘stop’.
